name: lawcel
description: Lawcel plugins for Claude Code. Connect a codebase to Lawcel's compliance platform so an agent can answer legal-profile questions from the code it is already reading.

plugins.name: lawcel
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to Lawcel. Adds the hosted Lawcel MCP server (browser sign-in, no API key) and a skill that gets the agent to answer your open legal-profile questions from evidence in the codebase.
